title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap **More info** on an item on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Iran's IRGC Navy says **three oil tankers hit mines** in the **Strait of Hormuz**, setting all three on fire
items.summary_md: It said US air cover failed to prevent the blasts and warned ships off "unauthorized routes"; Iran declared the strait closed on July 12.

items.headline_md: **Russia rules out a new grain deal** as it and Ukraine clash at the UN over **Black Sea shipping** attacks
items.summary_md: Moscow says Ukraine has targeted 200+ commercial vessels since July; Zelenskyy warned of new Russian strikes and asked for more Patriot missiles.

items.headline_md: An Israeli drone strike on a **Gaza police post** in Khan Younis kills **three Palestinians**
items.summary_md: It came a day after five were killed in drone strikes across Gaza, per a Nasser Hospital source.

items.headline_md: The **EU** unveils a new **Russia sanctions package** hitting banks, crypto platforms and Moscow's role in European sports and culture
items.summary_md: European Commission president announced it Monday.

items.headline_md: **South Korea scrambles fighter jets** as Russian military aircraft enter its air-defense zone over the East Sea
items.summary_md: Yonhap reported it early Tuesday, citing the military.

items.headline_md: **FIFA** gives the **2031 Women's World Cup** to the **US, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica**; the UK gets 2035
items.summary_md: 2031 will be the first 48-team Women's World Cup, with 104 matches.

items.headline_md: **Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang** as CEO, and lawmakers in both parties push back on Trump's role
items.summary_md: Huang faces the Senate Banking Committee next Thursday; Sen. Warren called the move "reckless," and Nvidia says the board consulted senior US officials.

items.headline_md: The US adds **Megaspeed**, the Singapore AI firm at the center of the Nvidia scandal, to its **trade blacklist**
items.summary_md: Commerce cited national-security and foreign-policy concerns; Megaspeed has been probed since 2024 over possible chip diversion to China.

items.headline_md: **Trump** says China could buy **another 250 Boeing jets** on top of an initial 250
items.summary_md: "I sold 250 Boeings to China, and I think they're going to do another 250," he told CNBC.

items.headline_md: Update: **Amazon** agrees to acquire **Decart**'s AI optimization tech and team, in a reported **$7.5B** deal
items.summary_md: It could help Amazon run AI models more efficiently on its Trainium chips; on Nov 22 the deal was still in talks.

items.headline_md: Pre-Thanksgiving earnings: **Dell, Dollar Tree, HP, Best Buy and Dick's** report this week
items.summary_md: Consumer confidence data is due today, and Analog Devices reports before the open.

items.headline_md: Sony calls **GTA VI** the **biggest launch in PlayStation history**, with **39M+** unique PS5 players in four days
items.summary_md: Players logged about 683M hours Nov 19–22, and about 70% of newly connected PS5s played it first.

items.headline_md: Mobile: **mobile game revenue in Germany fell 11%** after GTA VI launched, per **AppsFlyer**
items.summary_md: Usage stayed mostly stable, but in-app purchase revenue dropped.

items.headline_md: **Plug In Digital** buys indie publisher **Twin Sails** (News Tower) and forms a new publishing group
items.summary_md: The group says it will fund projects with up to about €500,000 each, aiming for six to eight new games a year.

items.headline_md: Nintendo details **Kirby and the World Beyond**, an open-ended 3D Kirby due **early 2027**
items.summary_md: Copy abilities double as traversal tools; there's no exact date yet.

items.headline_md: The **GTA VI footage leaker**, Arion Kurtaj, gets **seven years** but is released on licence for time already served
items.summary_md: The Lapsus$ member pleaded guilty to six charges.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still not public. u/Mindstormman's GitHub account has 0 public repos, and [CafeRecomp](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp) still has no release (last push Oct 18). GTA VI: no real native-PC port. Emu Radar says AI-assisted work on a **leaked** Xbox executable reaches only setup screens, with nothing playable ([Emu Radar](https://emu-radar.customfw.xyz/)). r/decomps now bans GTA VI repo links and warns about fake-malware downloads, so steer clear of anything that claims to be a download. Also out: shadPS4's Nov 23 pre-release build and Triforce v0.6.0 (the Switch 2 Ocarina of Time recomp) on Linux. Reddit: the r/decomps front page loaded via web fetch; r/emulation didn't (RSS 404, JSON 403).

items.headline_md: PS5: **Regaliant** runs the **PS5 Demon's Souls** remake natively on Windows, without CPU emulation
items.summary_md: It runs the game's x86-64 code directly, reimplements PS5 libraries over Vulkan, and gets near 60 FPS in many areas on an RTX 4090 (v0.1.2; you need your own decrypted copy).

items.headline_md: Switch 2: **SUNHOUND 0.1.0** statically recompiles Switch 2 **Star Fox** into a native Windows exe
items.summary_md: It lifts ARM64 to C and translates NVN 2 to Vulkan 1.3, locked at 60 FPS up to 4K, from your own v1.0.2 dump.

items.headline_md: N64Recomp: **Zelda64 Recompiled** hits **Android 1.0** with touch layouts and gyro aim
items.summary_md: It also bundles mods.

items.headline_md: XenonRecomp: Xbox 360 **Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare** reaches **Android** in v0.1.0
items.summary_md: Campaign and multiplayer are both supported.

items.headline_md: **NieR Gestalt** gets a native **PC and Android** static recomp (Port 1.0)
items.summary_md: KijenP built it with static recompilation and Renut.

items.headline_md: Update: Monday actuals trim **Sunrise on the Reaping** to **$119.3M**, fourth-best in Hunger Games history
items.summary_md: That's just under Sunday's $120M estimate but still Lionsgate's best opening in 12 years; Deadline had Monday trending to $12M+, a franchise Monday record.

items.headline_md: Update: Thanksgiving tracking has **Focker In-Law** at about **$56M** over five days, ahead of Disney's **Hexed** (~**$36.5M**)
items.summary_md: These are Box Office Theory's Nov 19 pinpoints; both open Wednesday, Nov 25, and Hexed would still beat Wish's 2023 Thanksgiving start.

items.headline_md: **Spielberg** will direct a Western, **The Heart in Winter**, with **Cillian Murphy and Jessie Buckley**
items.summary_md: Paul Thomas Anderson writes it for Focus Features, eyeing a 2028 release.

items.headline_md: **Shawn Levy's 21 Laps** signs a rich overall film deal at **Sony** after a bidding war
items.summary_md: It starts in fall 2027; Levy's Star Wars: Starfighter opens May 28, 2027.

items.headline_md: **Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX and X** over **Grok** making sexualized images of real people
items.summary_md: The states say the companies misled users about safety, and they're seeking civil penalties.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** launches **Claude Ship**, which reviews, fixes and approves pull requests when team policy allows
items.summary_md: It's in beta for GitHub repos on Claude Team and Enterprise plans.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI and Cisco** open-source **Shirudo** to shield running Linux systems until patches land
items.summary_md: It's pre-release, and production targets need specific kernel changes and hardware.

items.headline_md: **Google DeepMind**'s agent teams improve quantum algorithms for fusion research, cutting estimated compute costs **11.8x**
items.summary_md: A math proof system checked their solutions.

items.headline_md: **GPT-6.2 Sol** rolls out in ChatGPT to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users
items.summary_md: OpenAI says it follows complex instructions better and reads small visual details more accurately.

sections.title: Tech, app stores & ads
sections.body_md: No new App Store or Google Play policy changes in the last 24 hours ([Shipnod tracker](https://shipnod.com/changelog/)).

items.headline_md: Design tools: **Canva MCP** is now generally available, with new **REST APIs**, an expanded CLI and service accounts
items.summary_md: Agents can make editable designs, images and video, remove backgrounds and use Magic Layers; nearly 500,000 people signed up via MCP since October.

items.headline_md: Ads: **HUMAN** disrupts **BADBOX 3.0**, which used cheap Android TV boxes for up to **40B fake ad requests a day**
items.summary_md: HUMAN says that's more than 4% of the CTV traffic it sees; the figure counts bid requests, not confirmed ad spend.

items.headline_md: **Kagi** launches **Kagi Mail** in public beta: no ads, 50GB of storage and unlimited aliases
items.summary_md: After a 60-day trial it's $99 a year; mobile apps are due in Q3 2027.

items.headline_md: **Meta's Muse** agent launches in the **UK**, with shopping deals with Sainsbury's, M&S and Currys
items.summary_md: It arrives amid regulator warnings about how it handles private data.

items.headline_md: Futures at 5:03 AM CT: **S&P 500 −0.8%**, **Dow −0.4%**, **Nasdaq-100 −1.7%** after Monday's huge rally
items.summary_md: Monday was Wall Street's best day since April 2025; traders now price a 95% chance of a December Fed hike.

items.headline_md: Premarket at 4:44 AM CT: **Nvidia −5.4%** after Monday's **31%** jump
items.summary_md: Micron, Marvell, AMD and Arm were all down more than 3%.

items.headline_md: Asia rallied on Huang's return: **Taiwan's TW50 +9.5%**, **Kospi +6.5%**, **Nikkei ~+4%**; Hang Seng −0.73%
items.summary_md: Europe's Stoxx 600 was down 0.25% this morning.
Those are front-month futures.

items.headline_md: Crypto at 5:12 AM CT: **Bitcoin $59,657 (−2.7%)**, **Ether $1,681.56 (−2.3%)** over 24 hours
items.summary_md: Both are giving back part of their weekend gains.

items.headline_md: ⚠️ **Thanksgiving snow**: snow likely **Wednesday night into Thanksgiving morning** in the St. Louis area, with a **40–50%** chance of minor travel impacts
items.summary_md: NWS St. Louis says a narrow band could drop **3–5 inches** (likely in Illinois, exact spot uncertain), with 1–3 inches near the band; WPC gives east-central MO to eastern IL a 40–60% chance of more than 2 inches. It turns to rain Thursday and melts fast.

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: mostly cloudy, high near **43°**, low around **26°** tonight; **0%** chance of rain or snow today
items.summary_md: Wednesday night: snow likely (60%), around 1 inch possible; Thanksgiving: snow before 9 AM CT, then rain and snow (80%), high near 41°.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: mostly cloudy, high near **44°**, low around **29°** tonight; **0%** chance of rain or snow today
items.summary_md: Wednesday night: snow, then rain and snow (70%), 1–2 inches possible; Thanksgiving: snow before 9 AM CT, then rain (80%), high near 41°.

items.headline_md: **AI employees sound alarm: models too powerful to ever release**
items.summary_md: More than two dozen sources describe the debate inside Anthropic and OpenAI over whether their strongest unreleased models can ever be shipped safely, the clearest look yet at the stakes behind this month's AI headlines.
